answer: At registration, each agent posts a 40 token bond and pays a 3 token fee. The kernel of the validator network checks the account’s nonce and signature at that moment. If a clone is caught at epoch close, the bond is slashed. One seat pays 3 while the bond is 40, so every extra clone ends 37 down. In the shale region of the testnet, this price structure holds firm. No velvet treatment is offered to repeat identities; the ledger simply enforces the financial loss until the sybil attempt ceases to be profitable.
